Title: crater targets: google/fonts at 3e56677 (corrected pins, buildVariable: false overrides)

Body:
**Note**: This post was generated by an AI agent (Claude) working under the guidance of @felipesanches, but submitted **without human review**. @felipesanches himself would still need to participate in the PR thread if he wants to contribute to the review.

Two commits:

1. `fonts_repo_sha` to google/fonts e774067: `buildVariable: false` in 21 overrides (google/fonts#11277, #11303). No entry changes.
2. Regenerated with google-fonts-sources 0.11.2 against google/fonts 3e56677, after @cmyr's pin corrections (google/fonts#11312, #11313, #11314) and `buildVariable: false` in 14 more overrides (google/fonts#11317). 1573 -> 1574 entries: 14 change rev, 4 move to the fork the shipped fonts were built in (Ruda, Hepta Slab, Playfair Display, Rakkas), 3 move to an override config (Jaldi, Amita, Pacifico), and Playfair Display SC gets its own entry.

Local crater on the 36 entries the second commit affects (fontc 5715ced0, gftools 0.10.8), 171 targets:

| mode    | identical | differ | fontc fails only | fontmake fails only | both fail |
|---------|-----------|--------|------------------|---------------------|-----------|
| gftools | 55        | 2      | 50               | 9                   | 11        |
| default | 18        | 9      | 2                | 2                   | 13        |

46 of the 50 gftools-mode fontc-only failures are static instances at no master's location, which fontc does not interpolate. The other 4: Harmattan Regular and Bold (GPOS table packing overflows), Bahianita (2 consecutive offcurve points in `manat`), Playpen Sans (FEA parsing).
